question: What did the old prophet do just before speaking to the man of God?

readings.answer: He found him sitting under an oak tree.
readings.support: He found him sitting under an oak tree

assessments.reason: Verse 14 states, “He found him sitting under an oak tree and asked,” so finding him under the oak directly precedes speaking; “him” clearly refers to the man of God.

reason: The text explicitly says he found the man of God sitting under an oak tree immediately before asking him a question.
